title: Using the game window to select collisions generated by PhysicsServer3D at runtime crashes the window
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4 stable
- Older versions don't have the game window

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+, Mobile, Compatibility) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads)

### Issue description

Selecting a collider from the game windows that has been generated at runtime using PhysicsServer3D crashes the game window.

### Steps to reproduce

- Place following code on a MeshInstance3D
- Play scene
- From game window, use select Node 3D mode
- Click on MeshInstance3D object (maybe 2 times to cycle to it)

```
extends MeshInstance3D
var shape_rid: RID
var body_rid: RID

func _ready() -> void:
	generate_collision()

func generate_collision() -> void:
	shape_rid = mesh.create_trimesh_shape()
	body_rid = PhysicsServer3D.body_create()
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_space(body_rid, get_world_3d().space)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_add_shape(body_rid, shape_rid)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_shape_transform(body_rid, 0, Transform3D.IDENTITY)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_state(body_rid, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_TRANSFORM, global_transform)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_mode(body_rid, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_STATIC)
```
